{{Short description|Italian mathematician}}
[[File:Mark A. de Cataldo Oberwolfach 2017.jpg|thumb|De Cataldo at [[Mathematisches Forschungsinstitut Oberwolfach|Oberwolfach]] in 2017]]
'''Mark Andrea de Cataldo''' is an Italian mathematician.

De Cataldo earned a doctorate from the [[University of Notre Dame]] in 1995, and began teaching at [[Stony Brook University]] in 1998–1999, after completing postdoctoral research at the [[Washington University in St. Louis]], the [[Max Planck Institute for Mathematics]], and [[Harvard University]].<ref name="sbu">{{cite news |title=Mark Andrea de Cataldo |url=http://www.math.stonybrook.edu/~mde/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Stony Brook University}}</ref><ref name="fias">{{cite news |title=Prof. Dr. Mark Andrea de Cataldo |url=https://www.frias.uni-freiburg.de/en/people/fellows/current-fellows/de-cataldo |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Freiburg Institute For Advanced Studies}}</ref> He is a member of the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] and has been awarded the [[Simons Foundation]] fellowship.<ref name="ias">{{cite news |title=Mark de Cataldo |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/mark-de-cataldo |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Institute for Advanced Study}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Mark Andrea de Cataldo, Ph.D. |url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/people/mark-andrea-de-cataldo/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Simons Foundation}}</ref> In 2019, de Cataldo was elected a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Christopher Bishop and Mark De Cataldo Named 2019 American Mathematical Society Fellows |url=https://news.stonybrook.edu/facultystaff/christopher-bishop-and-mark-de-cataldo-named-2019-american-mathematical-society-fellows/ |access-date=3 April 2022 |publisher=Stony Brook University |date=8 November 2018}}</ref>
